items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I actually... also was with Stan Getz. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: So you were talkin’ about that band there, and of course I have the recording here, The Very Big Carla Bley Band. And, you know, I was listening to this and it just knocked me out, and I’ve heard Victor play many times live and also with Bobby Watson in a variety of settings. I actually... also was with Stan Getz.
